question:
FULL-SITE NUMBER AUDIT, ROUND 3 (confirmation) for papertrades.ai. Attached: canon-nov1.txt (correct numbers from the records), site-text-nov1b.txt (every page, all three models, captured after the fixes) and site-overview-nov1b.txt (overview pages).
In round 2 you both found no HIGH problems. These items were then fixed: (a) Currencies summary now adds up: deposit + open profit + closed profit + "Price corrections" line = account value (Gemini: 100,000 − 57 + 238 − 200 = 99,981); (b) the currency rows show open profit only, column renamed; (c) holding percentages now always add to 100; (d) FX "Cash not invested" relabelled as a cash balance that includes borrowed money still owed; (e) Gemini's All in bets footer now "11 rows (17 bets; repeats of the same pick grouped)"; (f) China hours lead with the new ET times; (g) yen cover dated Oct 28, 10:14 p.m. ET; (h) the guide no longer says Overall amounts are hidden; (i) the All in daily-minimum total now counts only from Nov 1 (it used to add older side bets, which showed Gemini at a confusing total).

Be strict and specific. End with one line: "VERDICT: CLEAN" or "VERDICT: PROBLEMS FOUND".
